articles.summary: Macy’s, Inc. (NYSE: M) today announced the appointment of Alexandre (Alex) Choueiri as Chief Executive Officer of Bluemercury. Choueiri will join the company on August 3, 2026, reporting directly to Olivier Bron, Chief Executive Officer of Bloomingdale’s. In this role, Choueiri will lead Bluemercury’s overall business and growth strategy, building on the brand’s position as a leading luxury beauty retailer. “As we welcome Alex to Macy’s, Inc. I want to thank our Bluemercury colleagues for their strong focus and execution over the past year. Their progress against our strategy, including driving consistent growth in dermatological skincare, color and fragrance has strengthened Bluemercury’s position as a trusted destination for prestige beauty,” said Bron. “Alex is a proven global leader with deep beauty expertise and a record of leading complex global organizations. articles.title: Macy’s, Inc. Appoints Alexandre Choueiri as CEO of Bluemercury
